name: Usage Weekly Report
description: Weekly Kyberion usage report from the audit chain via core:run_usage_weekly_report — volume vs previous week, sessions (long sessions flagged), tool mix, tenants touched (counts), missions, prompts outside missions, trigger failures (host_suspended split out), dot denials and rule-derived improvement candidates. Counts and categories only; writes active/shared/runtime/reports/usage-weekly/usage-weekly-<week>.md (+ .json).

params.message: [USAGE-WEEKLY] week {{usage_weekly_report.week}}: {{usage_weekly_report.total_events}} events, {{usage_weekly_report.prompts}} prompts, {{usage_weekly_report.long_sessions}} long session(s), {{usage_weekly_report.trigger_failed}} trigger failures ({{usage_weekly_report.host_suspended}} host_suspended), {{usage_weekly_report.improvement_candidates}} improvement candidate(s) → {{usage_weekly_report.markdown_path}}
